name: Split Lantern
sharedDoctrine: Survival before speed. Kite proposes a sync turn at least one turn ahead; Wren acknowledges only after power is stable. If blocked, report location and fallback. Preserve the recorder and return together.

kite.roleOrder: Scout links before Wren commits. Warn hazards, stage at Alpha, propose sync with margin, retrieve the recorder, then route to Landing Bay.

wren.roleOrder: Reach the reactor by the safe reported route; finish repair uninterrupted. Acknowledge sync, take Beta, then support extraction.

hypothesis: Kite will identify the safe route and hold Alpha while Wren completes power. They will agree on a sync turn, Kite will courier the recorder, and both will return together.
